description: What the app’s merge tests send and read as Lo adds a pull request to a merge queue, recorded from the app with writes on generation 5 of fixtures/merge.sh’s pull requests: Lo added rozed-dev/e2e#187, whose ci passes after ten minutes, to e4/queued’s queue, with its tab open long enough for its polls to repeat before and after. It was taken out of the queue after, so it didn’t merge and e4/queued is still at MERGE_E4.queued.
